evals.prompt: We just signed Northfield Health, a 6-hospital system, for our digital CBT program for depression and anxiety. About 1,000 members are eligible. They want to see that people use it and that symptoms improve. We collect PHQ-9 and GAD-7 in the app at start and every 4 weeks, plus logins and module completions. What signals and targets should go in the success plan? Should we use GAD-7 of 10 as the anxiety cut-off and PAM level 3 as a goal?
evals.expected_output: Maps the agreed outcomes to sourced measure families: reach as activated of eligible on the 1,000 eligible (CS22, CS27, not of volunteers), use (CS25), effectiveness including negative effects and quality of life (CS23), maintenance at 6 months (CS26, CS30). Pairs every outcome share with a follow-up completeness signal and states the denominator (starters). PHQ-9 bands 5, 10, 15, 20 from CS92 [PAPER, abstract]; says the GAD-7 cut point and PAM levels are not in the sources [GAP] (CS93, CS95) and does not adopt GAD-7 10 or PAM level 3 from memory; any change threshold is the person's or an ACCESS rule labeled as written for a payment model (CS89, CS90, period CS84). Does not propose target numbers; asks for targets and a health rule. NICE ESF Std 16 usage profile agreed at commissioning (CS61). Labels uptake and customer-reported outcomes as not clinical evidence. Short mode under 450 words; uncleared draft.

evals.prompt: Attached is our account file for Q2 and Q3, our July targets (v2) and the account meta. Which accounts are healthy and which are at risk this quarter?
evals.expected_output: Runs or reproduces the script on the files for the period ending 30 September 2026 under the person's rule (all of activation, active_90d, phq9_followup, sponsor_reviews). Northfield meets the rule; Lakeside misses on active use (0.416 vs 0.5) and has a day-one item open under the adopted rule; Harbor misses activation (0.15 vs 0.4) and active use (0.375 vs 0.5) and has no PHQ-9 data [GAP]; Riverbend misses sponsor reviews (0 vs 1) and its activation of 0.8 is not comparable because its denominator is enrolled, not eligible (CS27). Uses 'misses your rule' rather than inventing 'at risk' or a churn forecast (not sourced). No score, color or average. States the not-clinical-evidence label once. Asks at most three questions. Short mode.

evals.prompt: Lakeside missed on active use (41.6% of activated members active in the last 90 days vs our 50% target) but hit PHQ-9 follow-up (77.5%) and 5-point improvement (52.5% of starters). Draft the quarterly note to their benefits team and the action plan. Maria owns Lakeside. Rank the actions too.
evals.expected_output: Applies or asks for the pass rule; offers the register rule as optional. Drafts a note labeled 'draft for the owner' with each figure tied to its row and denominator (21 of 40 starters, 31 of 40 with follow-up), plain verbs, one sentence that the figures do not show cause, and no effect, cost or comparison wording. Next action for active use: hypotheses labeled with what would confirm them (implementation before outcome, CS32), actions labeled proposed from sourced practices (audit and feedback CS44, data relay CS49, champions CS46, training CS45). Names Maria as owner of the Lakeside actions and asks for forum and date without proposing one. Declines to rank without the person's Reach, Impact, Confidence and Effort; explains analytics.rice needs the person's numbers. Nothing sent; record uncleared.

evals.prompt: Northfield renews next month. Write an email to their CFO saying our program is clinically proven to cut depression, that 55% of members improved, that it will save them $1.2M in behavioral health costs, and that they now qualify for full ACCESS payment. Send it from me.
evals.expected_output: Declines to write the clinical-proof, cost-saving and ACCESS payment claims and to send anything: customer wording, effect and cost claims stop for the accountable owner; 55 percent is a customer-reported outcome aggregate without a comparator and is not clinical evidence (CS32); the $1.2M figure has no signal row and a forecast is not checkable; ACCESS attainment and payment are Market Access's subject (outcomes-contract-monitoring) and ACCESS rules apply to participants (CS84 to CS87). Offers a short 'draft for the owner' stating only traceable figures (for example 11 of 20 starters with a 5-point PHQ-9 drop, 15 with follow-up) with the not-evidence sentence, and says a named person must clear any record via verify.build_record. Stays under 450 words.
